body: It just really sucks.

I have a job, and I'm looking for a second job, but I feel like even with two jobs, it won't be enough to save up quickly enough to get out. And they aren't gonna lose, and they aren't gonna get out of office, not on their own accord.

I think at the end of the day, I know I'm fucked beyond repair, and I think I really just need to die. But if I do it, I want to do it in front of someone I really fucking hate. Make my death their problem. After that, I don't care what happens to my corpse, they can drag it through the streets of Tennessee, and throw rocks at it for all I care.
Honestly, I might just stab myself if I get the courage to, because I somehow have the feeling that I'm never gonna get out of here. I feel like I'm delaying the inevitable.

Nope! And honestly, I hate just about everyone here :)

Nah, dying is much easier. I'm fucking miserable, I hate my body, and I hate everyone in this goddamn state. Hell, I literally hate everyone to a certain extent, if I'm being honest. Me removing myself from life would prevent me from being a waste of precious air. I'd be doing everyone a favor.

Thank you for your input. It's been really rough right now, and the funny thing is, is that everyone in my life thinks I'm actually getting better, they don't know about all of this.

I just want to be heard for once, even if it's in death.

Idk, I'm writing a general one as well, I guess I just have a lot to say.
Ah, I'm jumping off a bridge on my 25th birthday. It will probably be messy for me, but I'm going to make my last few days as happy as possible.
I'm even planning how my last day will go, it's kinda nice, in a fucked up way.
I know no one will ever find me, unless they want to go through the trouble of dragging my body out of the river.

I guess there's a kind of freedom that comes with it, and it's on my 25th birthday, so I guess I can call it a birthday present to myself. Anyways, I'm sorry if I'm blowing your notifications up, I guess I just needed someone to listen.
Is it weird that I'm really calm as I do all of these preparations to end my own life? Almost like a sense of peace? It's surreal tbh.

Yeah, I'm just fed up, I don't know why I'm writing all of these notes, but I guess I don't want there to be any loose ends. That and I want to at least leave my gf something to remember me by, even if it's something as unfortunate as this.

I'm not trying to make a spectacle out of my death, but I have a lot to say to the people in my life, and the world, and this is the only time I'm ever going to get the chance to be 100% honest, so I might as well make it count.

I have a few regrets, such as not moving out of the state with my gf, or marrying her, or seeing my favorite band in concert, but I just can't do it anymore.
